notes: Express 5.x is the course baseline. Official Express docs are primary for framework APIs and migration; Node.js release schedule is the authority for runtime support. Check current package versions and validate runnable code in a real local environment before publication. External packages (e.g. pg, bcrypt, helmet, cors, multer, express-rate-limit, express-session and supertest) are not built-in Express features.

references.title: Express.js 5.x documentation
supports: Framework concepts and Express 5 documentation index.

references.title: Express.js API reference
supports: Application, request, response, Router, built-in middleware APIs and current signatures.

references.title: Express.js routing guide (5.x)
supports: Route methods, paths, handlers, app.route() and express.Router().

supports: Application-level, router-level, error-handling and third-party middleware composition.

references.title: Error handling (5.x)

references.title: Express.js security best practices
